exit 0
--- stdout
[] clean=. dir=. base=. ext=
[/] clean=/ dir=/ base=/ ext=
[//] clean=/ dir=/ base=/ ext=
[.] clean=. dir=. base=. ext=.
[..] clean=.. dir=. base=.. ext=.
[./] clean=. dir=. base=. ext=
[../..] clean=../.. dir=.. base=.. ext=.
[a/..] clean=. dir=a base=.. ext=.
[a/../..] clean=.. dir=. base=.. ext=.
[/../a] clean=/a dir=/ base=a ext=
[a/b/../../..] clean=.. dir=. base=.. ext=.
[/a/b/../../../c] clean=/c dir=/ base=c ext=
[abc.] clean=abc. dir=. base=abc. ext=.
[.hidden] clean=.hidden dir=. base=.hidden ext=.hidden
[a.b/c] clean=a.b/c dir=a.b base=c ext=
[x/] clean=x dir=x base=x ext=
[/a/b/] clean=/a/b dir=/a/b base=b ext=
[a//b] clean=a/b dir=a base=b ext=
[./a] clean=a dir=. base=a ext=
[a/./b/.] clean=a/b dir=a/b base=. ext=.
[...] clean=... dir=. base=... ext=.
[a/.../b] clean=a/.../b dir=a/... base=b ext=
[/..] clean=/ dir=/ base=.. ext=.
[../a/../b] clean=../b dir=.. base=b ext=
[dir/file.tar.gz] clean=dir/file.tar.gz dir=dir base=file.tar.gz ext=.gz
[noext] clean=noext dir=. base=noext ext=
[a.b.c/] clean=a.b.c dir=a.b.c base=a.b.c ext=
[é/ü.txt] clean=é/ü.txt dir=é base=ü.txt ext=.txt
[a/b/c/../d/./e.f] clean=a/b/d/e.f dir=a/b/d base=e.f ext=.f
join(, ) = 
join(a, ) = a
join(, b) = b
join(a, b) = a/b
join(a/, /b) = a/b
join(/, x) = /x
join(a/b, ../../..) = ..
join(.., a) = ../a
join(x, /) = x
split[] = dir=[] file=[] is_abs=false
split[/] = dir=[/] file=[] is_abs=true
split[//] = dir=[//] file=[] is_abs=true
split[.] = dir=[] file=[.] is_abs=false
split[..] = dir=[] file=[..] is_abs=false
split[./] = dir=[./] file=[] is_abs=false
split[../..] = dir=[../] file=[..] is_abs=false
split[a/..] = dir=[a/] file=[..] is_abs=false
split[a/../..] = dir=[a/../] file=[..] is_abs=false
split[/../a] = dir=[/../] file=[a] is_abs=true
split[a/b/../../..] = dir=[a/b/../../] file=[..] is_abs=false
split[/a/b/../../../c] = dir=[/a/b/../../../] file=[c] is_abs=true
split[abc.] = dir=[] file=[abc.] is_abs=false
split[.hidden] = dir=[] file=[.hidden] is_abs=false
split[a.b/c] = dir=[a.b/] file=[c] is_abs=false
split[x/] = dir=[x/] file=[] is_abs=false
split[/a/b/] = dir=[/a/b/] file=[] is_abs=true
split[a//b] = dir=[a//] file=[b] is_abs=false
split[./a] = dir=[./] file=[a] is_abs=false
split[a/./b/.] = dir=[a/./b/] file=[.] is_abs=false
split[...] = dir=[] file=[...] is_abs=false
split[a/.../b] = dir=[a/.../] file=[b] is_abs=false
split[/..] = dir=[/] file=[..] is_abs=true
split[../a/../b] = dir=[../a/../] file=[b] is_abs=false
split[dir/file.tar.gz] = dir=[dir/] file=[file.tar.gz] is_abs=false
split[noext] = dir=[] file=[noext] is_abs=false
split[a.b.c/] = dir=[a.b.c/] file=[] is_abs=false
split[é/ü.txt] = dir=[é/] file=[ü.txt] is_abs=false
split[a/b/c/../d/./e.f] = dir=[a/b/c/../d/./] file=[e.f] is_abs=false
is_match(abc, abc) = true
is_match(*, abc) = true
is_match(a*, ab/c) = false
is_match(a*b?c*x, abxbbxdbxebxczzx) = true
is_match(ab[c], abc) = true
is_match(ab[^c], abc) = false
is_match(a\*b, a*b) = true
is_match(a?b, a☺b) = true
is_match([a-ζ]*, α) = true
is_match([\]a], ]) = true
is_match([x\-], -) = true
is_match([]a], ]) = invalid path pattern "[]a]": syntax error in pattern
is_match([-], -) = invalid path pattern "[-]": syntax error in pattern
is_match([a-b-c], a) = invalid path pattern "[a-b-c]": syntax error in pattern
is_match(\, a) = invalid path pattern "\\": syntax error in pattern
is_match(a/b[, x) = invalid path pattern "a/b[": syntax error in pattern
is_match(*x, xxx) = true
is_match(é?, éa) = true
is_match(a[b-d]?, ac1) = true
